purpose: Determine whether THIS sandbox runner can execute the production-like readiness harness (Docker Engine + Docker Compose + sufficient CPU/RAM/disk + permission to create isolated test data and services). This is a capability determination only. It is NOT execution evidence for any D8 production-readiness probe and must never be counted as one.

Docker Engine cannot be installed: the Debian apt mirrors (deb.debian.org) and download.docker.com are both unreachable from this sandbox, so apt-get update fails and no package index exists.
/lib/modules is absent, so kernel modules required for container networking/storage cannot be loaded, and /proc is mounted read-only.
Resources are below the production-like envelope: 2 vCPU and ~3.8 GiB RAM, against a full Frappe/ERPNext/Education/HRMS bench plus MariaDB and Redis.

Consequence: every live-service probe (MariaDB durability/restart, Redis persistence/restart recovery, deployed Frappe runtime, TLS/edge, monitoring delivery) is ENVIRONMENT-BLOCKED on this host and must be executed on a Docker-capable runner instead.
